digest.component_or_area: release.yml workflow and GitHub release process
propositions: Release workflow currently accepts arbitrary pushed v* tags with no verification that the tagged SHA is an ancestor of or equal to reviewed main, allowing unreviewed commits to reach PyPI

Three version values (pyproject.toml, server.json top-level, server.json packages[].version) are kept in lockstep only by manual runbook, risking mismatched versions published across PyPI, GitHub Release, and MCP channels

Release must be re-anchored to workflow_dispatch-from-main trigger with version-lockstep + ancestry validation before build, then publish directly via PyPA OIDC trusted publishing gated on a reviewer-approved pypi environment keyed to main-only dispatch

Release-time preflight step must query the live pypi environment configuration and fail closed if required reviewers or main-only deployment-branch policy are absent, detecting drift autonomously at release time
The v* tag and GitHub Release must be created only after successful publish as record outputs, not as triggers, eliminating the tag-relay surface and intermediate secret
